description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements The target is within range of your limited telepathy.

You reach out and sense the surface thoughts of your foe, helping you predict exactly where they're going to be so you can strike true. Attempt a Perception check to [[/act sense-motive]].

Critical Success As success, except your attack also it deals 2 additional precision damage if you're trained in Perception, 4 if you're expert, 6 if you're master, and 8 if you're legendary.

Success The next time you make an attack roll against the target, roll twice and use the better result. If your attack is a critical hit, the target is so surprised by the efficacy of your attack that they're also @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Off-Guard] until the beginning of your next turn.
